fairness.attribution: This isolated panel adds only the missing matched-parameter token-SAE baseline on the exact same frozen sparse tasks.
fairness.capacity_regime: The sparse narrowband tasks contain 24 ground-truth causes but only four are active per episode. TXC has 64 unconstrained atoms; parameter-matched spectral arms have 255 band-limited atoms. The balanced versus high-crowded tasks test whether learned routing follows frequency-specific dictionary demand.
fairness.data: All models receive identical seeded training episodes and episode-disjoint probe/eval episodes with one shared orthonormal observation dictionary.
fairness.noise: The adaptive arms apply a synthetic-task noise-floor heuristic: the expected white-noise contribution sigma^2/T is subtracted and clamped from per-band power and residual estimates. Because reconstruction depends on the noisy input, this is not an unbiased residual correction. Main reconstruction loss still uses the original noisy observations.
fairness.parameters: The token SAE uses 512 atoms (49,712 trainable parameters), within 0.4% of TXC (49,600) and the spectral arms (49,503-49,507).
fairness.primary_metric: Direct latent reconstruction R2 projects reconstructed observations onto known orthonormal emission directions, avoiding a wider-dictionary probe advantage.
fairness.support: The token SAE uses one active feature per token, hence nominal L0=W per analysis window, matching TXC and the spectral arms.

overall_spend.note: Conservative cumulative estimate through both routed spectral seeds. This final matched-SAE ledger has an independent $1.40 hard stop.
